notes: imd/acc on Robinhood Chain (chain 4663): deploy only ProjectRegistry, which records the projects whose cashback earns points through IdentityMD oracle panels and Intake v2. The constructor arguments name Intake v2, Robinhood Chain IMD, the live RemoteStacker of launch #1537, the oracle signer, question chain 4663, a 20 IMD challenge bond and a 7-day cooldown (604800 seconds), in that order. The registry names the RemoteStacker in its questions and never calls it. RemoteStacker, Stacker, StackReceiver and the test/trial contracts are not deployed. Cashback of 25-100 bps is funded from each project's existing fees, waits in the live RemoteStacker and reaches traders as sIMD on Ethereum through IMD's own bridge; only listed projects' credits earn points. The accepted registry and OracleAttestation source are unchanged. Panel rules are version 3.1, as for the mainnet registry of launch #1495 (0x7f53fa1543c682bb5de3f50c2cf3d1842ae57faa). There is no registry owner and the constructor makes no external call. For a project reporting an owner, only that owner or the project itself may apply, checked before fees; anyone may apply for an ownerless project. The registry itself is refused as beneficiary. Each ask pays the fee quoted live by Intake through ORACLE_FEE() (reported as 0.5 IMD on 2026-10-13); a challenge also posts the 20 IMD bond. Questions use requestWithFailure, eight definitions and chain 4663, with a 15-seat panel and quorum 11. Result callbacks accept only Intake, an open request and an unused answer signed by the fixed oracle signer for this contract and chain, with request-time checks and 300-second tolerance. Yes lists or defends; no rejects or delists. A defended bond goes to the beneficiary without restarting cooldown; delisting, failure or expiry returns it to the challenger. Expiry clears a question after one day or once Intake completed it. Refused bond payments become bondOwed, recoverable through claimBond(to). Beneficiary handoffs wait while a question is open and occur at most once per day. Accepted limits, as agreed by the owner for the mainnet registry: a listed project's beneficiary can hold its single question slot by challenging it, paying the live oracle fee each round and receiving the bond when defended; every round re-judges the project and buys no immunity. A stranger can hold an ownerless project's application slot for the fee each round; owned projects are protected by the owner rule. The signer, Intake, action and panel constants are fixed for life.
